title: Bugs/659500 NO SAF-T: ExchangeRate is inverted and calculated CurrencyAmount is wrong for customer/vendor transactions
summary: Fixed inverted exchange rate and incorrect currency amount calculations for customer and vendor transactions in Norwegian SAF-T export, plus improved account mapping to include all accounts as required by tax regulations.
key_points: Corrected exchange rate inversion causing wrong CurrencyAmount calculations in SAF-T 1.30 and 1.40 files
Updated account mapping logic to include all chart of accounts in export regardless of period activity
Aligns with Norwegian Tax Administration requirements for complete account visibility in SAF-T files
Enhanced test coverage with additional validation for currency calculations and account handling
Changes affect both SAF-T 1.3 and 1.4 file generation
